company.name: SunDrive
company.mission: Pioneering the world's most efficient commercial-scale copper solar cell technology with automated precision manufacturing.
strategicPriorities: Custom Automated Machinery & Robotic Validation Jigs
Precision Sensor, Motor & PLC Motion Control Integration
High-Speed Lab Automation & Continuous Equipment Optimization

role.title: Junior Mechatronics Engineer
role.overview: Design, build, assemble, and test custom automated machinery, jigs, fixtures, and robotic validation systems for cutting-edge solar cell fabrication.

advertisedRequirements: Degree or near-completion in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering
Hands-on experience with CAD (SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360)
Practical aptitude in rapid prototyping, wiring, sensor integration, and microcontrollers/PLCs (STM32, Beckhoff, Siemens)
Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or structured text
Agility and problem-solving instincts in a fast-paced hardware R&D environment

identifiedOperationalBottlenecks.teamStrain: Senior mechatronics engineers spend excessive time debugging test fixture control loops and writing repetitive driver code.
Manual data extraction from automated fabrication rigs creates bottlenecks in cycle-time analysis.
Documenting validation test protocols and compliance requirements diverts time from hardware assembly.
